body.name: \mathsf H_{\mathrm{crit}}
body.construction: Adapt unknown-boundary experiment comparison to the joint four-cell binary law, obtain the optimized local recovery profiles for cutoff displacement and signed effect label, truncate and renormalize translated-cutoff mixtures at the support boundary, retain every first- and second-order likelihood coordinate that survives on the \(s=1\) faces indexed by \(T_n\) and \(\tau_n\), and solve the resulting fixed-\(\alpha\) connected-interval decision problem by test inversion.
